met_analysis:
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Haryana & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over East Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level continues to pass through Ferozepur, Dehradun, Shahjahanpur, Varanasi, Dehri, centre of Depression over Jharkhand and Digha & thence southeastwards to Northeast Bay of Bengal and extends upto 0.9 km above mean sea level with embedded cyclonic circulations over north Haryana & neighbourhood and East Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood.
The trough from the cyclonic circulation over East Uttar Pradesh to Gujarat across north Madhya Pradesh and southeast Rajasthan at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Punjab & neighbourhood at 5.8 km above mean sea level with a trough aloft at its axis at 7.6 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 75°E to the north of Lat. 30°N persists.
